original_title: No, Blade is not cancelled, Arkane artist confirms
summary_en: Fears for the highly anticipated Marvel's Blade game have been put to rest by an Arkane artist who confirmed the project is still in development. The reassurance comes after the game's absence from recent major showcases fueled cancellation rumors.
ai_analysis: This confirmation is a much-needed beacon of hope for fans of Arkane's unique design philosophy and the iconic vampire hunter, especially following the studio's recent struggles.

en.title: Arkane Artist Confirms Blade Game is NOT Cancelled, Urges Patience
en.summary: Fears for the highly anticipated Marvel's Blade game have been put to rest by an Arkane artist who confirmed the project is still in development. The reassurance comes after the game's absence from recent major showcases fueled cancellation rumors.
en.body:
For months, whispers and growing concerns have circulated about the fate of **Arkane Lyon's** ambitious Marvel's Blade game. After its conspicuous absence from the recent Xbox Games Showcase, many fans worried that the project, which has been in development for some time, might have been quietly cancelled. These anxieties were understandable, given the studio's challenging recent history, including the underperformance of **Dishonored 2** and the critical disappointment of **Redfall**, which led to the closure of **Arkane Austin**.

However, a beacon of hope has emerged directly from the studio. **Jean-Luc Monnet**, lead concept artist and assistant art director at Arkane, took to X (formerly Twitter) to address the speculation head-on. In a brief but pointed message, Monnet reassured fans that the game is very much alive, urging them to "Let us cook." This direct confirmation from an insider is a powerful counterpoint to the growing doomsaying and provides a much-needed proof of life for the vampire-slaying action title.

## A History of Doubt

The uncertainty surrounding **Marvel's Blade** is deeply rooted in the recent trajectory of **Arkane Studios**. While critically acclaimed for their masterful immersive sim experiences like **Dishonored** and **Prey**, commercial success has been more elusive. The closure of **Arkane Austin** in 2024, following the troubled launch of **Redfall**, cast a long shadow over the future of the entire studio. When **Blade** missed its second consecutive Xbox Games Showcase, it was natural for fans and observers to connect the dots and worry about its development status, especially with **Microsoft** eager to showcase its gaming prowess.

This latest confirmation from Monnet is crucial for Arkane, offering a vital piece of positive news amidst a period of significant pressure. It suggests that despite the setbacks and the quiet period, the team is diligently working to bring their vision of the half-vampire hunter to life, aiming to deliver the kind of unique, player-driven experience Arkane is known for.

## What This Means for Fans

For the passionate fanbase eager to step into the shoes of **Eric Brooks**, this confirmation is a significant relief. It validates the patience they've been asked to exercise, particularly after **Arkane Lyon co-creative director Dinga Bakaba** previously stated back in December that the game would be "a special game" and requested fans to trust the process. The absence from showcases was undoubtedly testing that patience, but Monnet's message serves as a direct acknowledgment of their concerns and a promise of good things to come. It reaffirms that **Marvel's Blade** is not just a concept, but a tangible project still very much on the horizon, even if details on its scope and release window remain scarce.

## What's Next

While **Jean-Luc Monnet's** statement provides a crucial update, specific details regarding **Marvel's Blade**, such as its official release date, platforms, and gameplay mechanics, have not yet been announced. Fans are encouraged to remain patient, as the studio continues its development cycle, with future showcases likely to be the venue for more substantial reveals.

tr.title: Arkane Sanatçısı Bıçak Oyununun İptal Edilmediğini Onayladı, Sabır İstedi
tr.summary: Marvel's Blade oyununun highly anticipated olması ve recent absence from major showcases nedeniyleCancellation rumors ortaya çıktı. Ancak Arkane sanatçısı Jean-Luc Monnet, oyunun hala geliştirme aşamasında olduğunu onayladı.
tr.body:
## Geliştirme Süreci
Marvel's Blade oyunu için aylardır endişe verici söylentiler dolaşmaktadır. Recent Xbox Games Showcase'dan sonra oyunun absence nedeniyle birçok fan, projenin sessizce iptal edildiğinden endişe duymaya başladı. Ancak Arkane Lyon'un lead concept artist ve assistant art director'u Jean-Luc Monnet, X (eski adıyla Twitter) üzerinden bu söylentilere doğrudan cevap verdi. Monnet, oyunun hala geliştirme aşamasında olduğunu onayladı ve fanlara "Bırakın biz pişirelim" dedi.

## Şüphe Dönemi
Marvel's Blade oyununun etrafındaki belirsizlik, Arkane Studios'un recent geçmişine dayanmaktadır. Dishonored ve Prey gibi masterful immersive sim experiences ile kritik başarı elde etmiş olsalar da, ticari başarı daha zor elde edilmiştir. Arkane Austin'in 2024'te kapanması ve Redfall'in sorunlu lansmanı, stüdyonun geleceği üzerine uzun bir gölge düşürmüştür. Blade oyununun ikinci kez Xbox Games Showcase'da absence olması, fanların ve gözlemcilerin doğal olarak endişe duymasına neden olmuştur.

## Jean-Luc Monnet'in Açıklaması
Monnet'in bu açıklaması, Arkane için kritik bir önem taşımaktadır. Stüdyonun recent dönemde yaşadığı baskıların ortasında, olumlu bir haber sunmaktadır. Bu, ekibin sessiz bir dönemden geçse de, yarı-vampir avcısı hakkında bir vizyonu hayata geçirmek için çalıştığını ve Arkane'in bilinen unique, player-driven deneyimini sunmayı amaçladıklarını göstermektedir.

## Fanlar İçin Ne Anlama Geliyor
Eric Brooks'un kıyafetlerine girmeye hevesli fanlar için bu onay, önemli bir rahatlama oldu. Arkane Lyon'un co-creative director'u Dinga Bakaba'nın Aralık ayında yaptığı açıklamayı doğruladı. Bakaba, oyunun "özel bir oyun" olacağını ve fanlardan süreci güvenerek beklemelerini istemişti. Showcaselerden absence olması, sabırlarını test etse de, Monnet'in mesajı endişelerine doğrudan bir cevap ve iyi şeyler için bir vaat oldu.

## Sonraki Adımlar
Jean-Luc Monnet'in açıklaması, kritik bir güncelleme sunuyor. Ancak Marvel's Blade oyununun resmi çıkış tarihi, platformları ve oyun mekanikleri hakkında específik detaylar henüz açıklanmadı. Fanlar, stüdyonun geliştirme döngüsüne devam etmesi nedeniyle sabırlı olmaya davet ediliyor. Gelecek gösteriler, daha önemli açıklamalar için muhtemel bir platform olacak.

es.title: Artista de Arkane confirma que el juego de Blade NO ha sido cancelado, pide paciencia
es.summary: Los temores sobre el futuro del esperado juego de Marvel's Blade han sido calmados por un artista de Arkane, quien confirmó que el proyecto sigue en desarrollo. Esta confirmación llega después de que la ausencia del juego en eventos recientes generara rumores de cancelación. El juego de Blade sigue vivo y el equipo de Arkane trabaja para ofrecer una experiencia única y emocionante a los jugadores.
es.body:
El juego de Marvel's Blade, desarrollado por Arkane Lyon, ha sido objeto de especulación en los últimos meses. La ausencia del juego en eventos recientes como el Xbox Games Showcase generó preocupación entre los fans, quienes temían que el proyecto hubiera sido cancelado. Sin embargo, un artista de Arkane ha salido a calmar los rumores.

## Un mensaje de esperanza
**Jean-Luc Monnet**, artista conceptual y director de arte asistente en Arkane, se expresó en X (anteriormente Twitter) para abordar los rumores directamente. En un mensaje breve pero contundente, Monnet aseguró a los fans que el juego sigue en desarrollo y pidió paciencia, diciendo "Dejen que cocinemos". Esta confirmación directa de un insider es un poderoso contrapunto a los rumores de cancelación y ofrece una prueba de vida para el título de acción de vampiros.

## Una historia de dudas
La incertidumbre sobre **Marvel's Blade** se remonta a la trayectoria reciente de **Arkane Studios**. Aunque la empresa ha recibido elogios por sus experiencias de simulación inmersiva como **Dishonored** y **Prey**, el éxito comercial ha sido más esquivo. El cierre de **Arkane Austin** en 2024, después del lanzamiento problemático de **Redfall**, generó sombras sobre el futuro de todo el estudio. Cuando **Blade** se perdió su segunda presentación consecutiva en el Xbox Games Showcase, fue natural que los fans y observadores se preocuparan por su estado de desarrollo, especialmente con **Microsoft** ansiosa por mostrar su poder en el gaming.

## Qué significa para los fans
Para la base de fans apasionados que ansían ponerse en los zapatos de **Eric Brooks**, esta confirmación es un gran alivio. Valida la paciencia que se les ha pedido, especialmente después de que **Dinga Bakaba**, codirector creativo de Arkane Lyon, afirmara en diciembre que el juego sería "algo especial" y pidió a los fans que confiaran en el proceso. La ausencia en eventos fue, sin duda, una prueba para esa paciencia, pero el mensaje de Monnet sirve como un reconocimiento directo de sus preocupaciones y una promesa de cosas buenas por venir.

## Próximos Pasos
Aunque la declaración de **Jean-Luc Monnet** ofrece una actualización crucial, detalles específicos sobre **Marvel's Blade**, como su fecha de lanzamiento oficial, plataformas y mecánicas de juego, aún no han sido anunciados. Los fans están invitados a seguir siendo pacientes, ya que el estudio continúa su ciclo de desarrollo, y es probable que futuros eventos sean el escenario para revelaciones más sustanciales.

content_raw: Despite what you may have heard, Marvel's Blade , the daywalker action game in development at Arkane, is not cancelled. The proof of life came from Arkane lead concept artist and assistant art director Jean-Luc Monnet, who delivered a short-but-pointed reassurance to fans on X after the game missed its second Xbox Showcase running. "Let us cook." pic.twitter.com/jLjlbRPD8l June 7, 2026 Concern about the fate of Blade, and Arkane as a whole, is understandable. Despite making some of the best immersive sims (and thus, by definition, some of the best videogames) ever, Arkane has struggled to put a genuine hit on the board. Dishonored 2 , despite its lineage, did not sell especially well , and Prey is a massively underappreciated gem; and the less said about the Bethesda-imposed live service catastrophe Redfall , the better. Microsoft closed Arkane Austin in 2024, a year after Redfall's release, and that brutal handling made the future of the studio as a whole seem far less certain than it should be. PC Gamer's Fraser Brown, in fact, wrote that the absence of Marvel's Blade during the Xbox Games Showcase had him worried about Arkane —and this was in 2025. Rolling through 2026 without even a reminder of its existence naturally conjured up even deeper concerns, especially given Microsoft's desire to prove that it's still in the fight—and the fact that it had relatively little to actually prove it. So it's reassuring news for Blade fans, but possibly still a bit of a stressful situation for the more specific crowd of PlayStation-owning Blade fans. As a licensed Marvel game, my assumption is that it will be released on all platforms—but platforms haven't been announced, and Microsoft's recently turned its eyes back to console exclusives as it gets ready to fight the next round of the console wars .
